copyToColumns: The copy-to range must name columns of the list, or be a single cell
copyToSmall: The copy-to range is too small for the records that match
criteriaTooShort: The criteria range needs a header row and at least one row of conditions
listTooShort: The list range needs a header row and at least one record
overlapsCriteria: The copy-to range overlaps the criteria range. Choose a place outside it
overlapsList: The copy-to range overlaps the list range. Choose a place outside the list
protected: The copy-to range is protected. Choose another place, or unprotect it first
unknownHeader: The criteria header "{header}" names no column of the list
